key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=25%) in pediatric patients: headache (60%), injection site reaction (59%), vomiting (48%), pyrexia (48%), pain in extremity (42%), vitamin D decreased (32%). In adults (>=5% and >= 2 more than placebo): back pain (15% vs 9%), headache (13% vs 9%), tooth infection (13% vs 9%), restless legs syndrome (12% vs 8%), vitamin D decreased (12% vs 5%). Risks include hypersensitivity, hyperphosphatemia and injection site reactions.
